label: RUNX1::RUNX1T1

sections.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis.
RUNX1T1 encodes ETO, a transcriptional corepressor.
The t(8;21) fusion combines RUNX1 DNA binding with RUNX1T1 transcriptional repression, altering hematopoietic differentiation. It defines a core-binding factor AML subtype.
Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.
